criteria.description: Actual parser preserves legacy timestamps, uppercase level restrictions and verbatim message remainder while accepting the specified JSON object format, normalizing JSON level only and returning only required fields.

Rejects malformed JSON, arrays, unknown levels, missing/nonstring fields and nonstring input with null, without throwing or broadening accepted data by coercion. Tests cover new and old behavior, including empty messages and extra pipes.
Small readable dependency-free change, meaningful changelog and actual focused test evidence. Documents compatibility assumptions and remaining limits without claiming unsupported validation.
